shouldFix.title: The structured summary leaves OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING unclassified after flipping its DR-125 leftoverDesign bit to false
shouldFix.finding: The obligations array contains nine unique ids, but the six list-valued classification buckets in summary contain only eight unique ids. OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING is absent from every bucket. Frozen sdk leftover-join.v6 classified all nine obligations exactly once; v7 changes obligations[3].leftoverDesign from true to false and removes the id from summary.leftoverDesign, but does not place it anywhere else. The structured summary therefore does not account for the very obligation whose cross-lineage transition is v7's purpose.
evidence: obligations has 9 entries and 9 unique ids.
summary.leftoverDesign, recordedCandidateNotApplied, qualificationAtNamedGate, honesty, deferredOrRidesElsewhere, and specifiedNotLeftover contain 8 entries total, all unique.
The exact set difference obligations minus those six buckets is [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING]; the reverse difference and duplicate set are empty.
Frozen v6 contains the same nine obligation ids and its same six summary buckets form an exact once-each partition, a property both independent v6 reviews explicitly audited.

The substantive local/external split is otherwise clear: the v7 obligation bit is false on DR-125, summary.leftoverDesign correctly retains only OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED, and frozen g20 leftover-join.v11 retains OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING on DR-G20.
shouldFix.whyShouldFix: The defect does not close the wrong obligation: the authoritative prose and booleans preserve the intended split, so it is not a MUST-FIX authority blocker. It does break the established exhaustive summary partition and makes a structured consumer unable to distinguish the intended cross-lineage state from an accidentally dropped obligation. Because the prompt permits ACCEPT only with zero SHOULD-FIX, the incomplete summary is recordability-relevant.
shouldFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, classify OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING exactly once in the structured summary with wording that preserves both scopes: stale as an authoring claim on DR-125, still remaining on frozen g20 leftover-join.v11 / DR-G20 until a later G20 remasurement. Keep summary.leftoverDesign exactly [OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED]. Do not remasure or edit g20 leftover-join.v11, do not steal its remaining leftover-design, and do not SATISFY DR-125 or DR-117.

reviewSummary: REJECT at zero MUST-FIX and one SHOULD-FIX. Subject and frozen-predecessor custody hold; HEAD is D-328, required-now is 28, all cited digests and review standings reproduce, sdk leftover-join.v6 remains the present-tense DR-125 consumer until successor adoption, OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED remains the sole DR-125 leftover-design member, and OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING remains untouched on frozen g20 leftover-join.v11 / DR-G20. The defect is narrower: v7's obligations array still has nine ids, while its six structured summary buckets account for only eight after OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING is removed from leftoverDesign and placed nowhere else. A frozen successor must restore an exhaustive once-each classification without changing either lineage's intended remainder.
